question: Which of the following countries was the host of AFC Women's Asia Cup Football–2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **AFC Women's Asia Cup:-**

 
 
• It is a** ****quadrennial**** football tournament** that is contested by the **national teams of Asia.**
 
• It is organized by the Asian Football Confederation (AFC).
 
• India is set to host the AFC Women's Asia Cup Football-2022.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Jordan was the **host of the previous edition **of the tournament in **2018**, where Japan emerged as the** champions** by defeating Australia in the final.
 
• **Bangladesh** has not yet hosted the AFC Women's Asia Cup.
 
 
• However, the country has hosted other AFC tournaments in the past, such as the **AFC U-16 Women's Championship.**
 
 
 
• **China** has hosted the** AFC Women's Asia Cup five times** in the past, which is the most by any country.
 
• The last time China hosted the tournament was in** 2014, **where they finished as the** runners-up after losing to Japan** in the final.
